recipe.title: Warm Cinnamon Apple Cheesecake Protein Parfait
recipe.summary: Warm cinnamon apples layered with thick vanilla cheesecake protein yogurt and almond butter in a clear dessert glass.
recipe.story: This fall parfait gives warm apple-cheesecake flavor while keeping the layers simple, measurable, and protein-forward.
recipe.serving_size: 1 clear glass dessert dish, about 1 1/2 cups
ingredients: 2 ounces apple, cored and finely diced
1 cup Chobani Zero Sugar Vanilla Greek Yogurt
1 scoop Clean Simple Eats Vanilla Protein Powder
2 tablespoons water, plus more only if needed
instructions: Add the diced apple, cinnamon, apple pie spice, vanilla, salt, and 1 tablespoon water to a small skillet over medium heat.
Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apple is warm and fork-tender but still holds its shape. Remove from the heat and cool for 3 minutes.
Stir the Greek yogurt, protein powder, 1 1/2 tablespoons almond butter, and 2 tablespoons water until completely smooth and thick. Add only enough extra water to reach a cheesecake-like consistency.
Spoon half of the cheesecake mixture into a clear glass dessert dish and add half of the warm apples.
Repeat the layers, then drizzle the remaining 1/2 tablespoon almond butter over the top.
Serve immediately while the apples are warm.
tips: Use a clear glass dessert dish so the cheesecake and apple layers remain visible.
For meal prep, refrigerate the yogurt mixture and cooked apples separately and assemble immediately before serving.
Weigh the edible apple portion to 2 ounces to keep the listed sugar and macros consistent.
